:= by
  have h1 : Nat.gcd (2 * n + 1) (n + 1) = Nat.gcd (n + 1) (2 * n + 1 - 2 * (n + 1)) := 
    Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_of_divides_right (Nat.dvd_sub (Nat.dvd_mul_right (n + 1) 2) (Nat.dvd_add (Nat.dvd_mul_right (n + 1) 2) (Nat.dvd_one (n + 1))))
  have h2 : 2 * n + 1 - 2 * (n + 1) = -1 := 
    by simp [Nat.sub_eq_add_neg, Nat.add_right_neg]
  have h3 : Nat.gcd (n + 1) (-1) = 1 := 
    by rw [Nat.gcd_abs_left, Nat.gcd_abs_right]; exact Nat.gcd_eq_one_of_dvd_one (Nat.dvd_neg_one (n + 1))
  have h4 : Nat.gcd (n + 1) (-1) = Nat.gcd (n + 1) 1 := 
    by rw [Nat.gcd_abs_left, Nat.gcd_abs_right]
  have h5 : Nat.gcd (n + 1) 1 = 1 := 
    by rw [Nat.gcd_one_left]
  rw [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5]
